'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''

**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Battle of Donbas (2022)|Battle of Donbas]]
****[[Battle of Sievierodonetsk (2022)|Battle of Sievierodonetsk]]
*****Two [[Reuters]] journalists are injured and their driver is killed after their vehicle is attacked while travelling to [[Sievierodonetsk]]. The perpetrators have not been identified. ***[[Russian occupation of Kharkiv Oblast]]
****Vitaly Ganchev is announced as head of the Kharkiv Military-Civilian Administration. His appointment might have happened earlier as he was ''de facto'' Governor since April 2022.<ref>[https://2day.kh.ua/ua/kharkow/novi-haulyaytery-kharkivskoyi-oblasti-yak-zminyuyetsya-vlada-na-okupovanykh-terytoriyakh (2day.kh.ua)] {{in lang|uk}}</ref>
'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 food crises]]
**[[Chad]] declares an emergency over [[food insecurity]] in the country. The [[United Nations]] estimates that more than a third of the population are in need of urgent [[humanitarian aid]]. [https://www.africanews.com/2022/06/03/chad-declares-food-emergency-calls-for-help-from-national-and-foreign-partners/ (Africanews)]
*[[Garmisch-Partenkirchen train derailment]]
**Five people are killed and 60 others are injured after a train [[derails]] in [[Garmisch-Partenkirchen]], [[Bavaria]], [[Germany]]. [https://www.voanews.com/a/6603312.html (VOA)]
*[[2022 Russian mystery fires]]
**A fire occurs in a building in [[Moscow]], [[Russia]], injuring at least four people, with 125 people being rescued. However, the total number of people trapped inside the building is unclear. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-moscow-fires-e5965f2a456ac3135c0bbfb6aea2594f (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**[[Latvia]] confirms its first case of [[monkeypox]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/latvia-records-first-case-monkeypox-2022-06-03/ (Reuters)]
**United States health officials say that 1,200 doses of the [[smallpox vaccine]] have been administered for patients considered at a high-risk for monkeypox. [https://amp.cnn.com/cnn/2022/06/03/health/monkeypox-vaccine-outbreak-cdc/index.html (CNN)] 

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2019–2022 Sudanese protests]]
**A protester is killed in [[Khartoum]] after security forces open fire on [[political demonstration|demonstrators]] on the third anniversary of the [[Khartoum massacre]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/protester-dies-gunshot-wound-demonstrations-sudan-capital-2022-06-03/ (Reuters)]
*[[Estonia]]'s coalition agreement collapses as the junior coalition partner, the [[Estonian Centre Party|Centre Party]], joins the far-right [[Conservative People's Party of Estonia|EKRE]] in defeating a government bill on primary education, and is subsequently expelled by [[Prime Minister of Estonia|Prime Minister]] [[Kaja Kallas]]. Kallas is expected to form a coalition with two other parties, [[Isamaa]] and the [[Social Democratic Party (Estonia)|Social Democrats]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/estonian-pm-removes-coalition-partner-government-2022-06-03/ (Reuters)]
*[[Germany]]'s [[Bundestag]] approves a [[Basic Law of Germany|constitutional]] amendment that enshrines [[Euro sign|€]]100 billion in military spending. The amendment must now pass the [[Bundesrat of Germany|Bundesrat]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20220603-germany-funds-army-update-to-face-russia-threat (AFP via France 24)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Legality of cryptocurrency by country or territory]]
**The [[U.S. state]] of [[New York (state)|New York]] passes a partial two-year [[cryptocurrency mining]] ban for [[cryptocurrency]] mined from [[fossil fuel]] [[power plant]]s. [https://www.politico.com/news/2022/06/03/new-york-pass-cryptocurrency-moratorium-00036946 (Politico)]

'''Sports'''
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports]]
**The [[Special Olympics]] lift their [[COVID-19 vaccination mandates in the United States|COVID-19 vaccine mandate]] for the upcoming [[Special Olympics USA]] event in [[Orlando, Florida|Orlando]], [[Florida]], after [[Governor of Florida|Governor]] [[Ron DeSantis]] urged them to do so or face threats of a [[United States dollar|$]]27.5 million fine. [https://floridapolitics.com/archives/529664-gov-desantis-pushes-special-olympics-to-lift-vaccine-mandate-on-usa-games/ (Florida Politics)] [https://syndication.bleacherreport.com/amp/10037585-special-olympics-threatened-with-275m-in-fines-over-vaccine-mandate-by-florida.amp.html (Bleacher Report)] [https://cbs12.com/amp/news/local/special-olympics-lifts-vaccine-mandate-ahead-of-orlando-games (WPEC-TV)]
